fusions.name: Seam Jab
fusions.desc: A quick strike with links that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and strips 10% of its armour for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unrolling Lash
fusions.desc: Uncoils in a lash, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Curl Tight
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 35% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Overlapping Seams
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (62% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. It also hardens your armour by 6% at all times.
